// types3.ts — A MODULE REACHABLE ONLY THROUGH AN ERASED RE-EXPORT.
//
// Nothing imports it and nothing re-exports a VALUE from it. Its only two
// mentions in this tree are exp.ts's `export { type T4 as ReT4 } from` and its
// `export type * from`, so `depends(exp.ts, types3.ts)` holds and
// `flows(exp.ts, types3.ts)` must not — and either erasure negation dropped
// from rules/js-modules.rofl §5b makes that edge appear. On any other target
// the appearance would be hidden by a second, value-carrying declaration.
export type T4 = { tag: 'T4' };
export type T5 = { tag: 'T5' };
